text: ‘Globalisation is leading to cultural convergence.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Globalisation is reducing poverty in developing societies.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘The cultural effects model provides the best explanation of how the media influences behaviour.’
Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The media is an agent of ideological control.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘The function of religion is to maintain social order.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Women have little power within religious organisations.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
